sections.title: Exercise:
paragraphs: Edit User Import File and Validate, Import
Instructions from Admin / Import Users from a File :
1. Make some edits/additions to your file and re-save (still as a .txt file!)
2. Select “Add/Update Users” and then “Validate” from the dropdowns in the box on the
3. Add a description and choose the file from your computer, then “Submit”
4. Watch the “ Recent Activity ” box on the right and “refresh” as needed until completion
5. Resolve errors if necessary and try again
6. After successful Validation, “ Click to Import ”
7. Go admire your new or updated users!
